system.description:
Lore: Relic Cube

Netherese wizards used them to keep their studies comfortable a thousand feet above a frozen glacier. Ten-Towns folk just call it a small miracle.

This 3-inch cube of solid brimstone radiates enough dry heat to keep the area within Close at a balmy 95 degrees Fahrenheit.

It has the following Powers:

  • Hearth: Radiates dry heat, holding the area within Close at a comfortable 95 degrees Fahrenheit. It never runs out.

Value: 50g
system.source: Icewind Dale: Rime of the Frostmaiden (Vagabond conversion)
